log.notes_to_self: Strategy: quick kills only in AFTERNOON (keeps pool to night/student/home = 55%). Prefer national-reported criminals (traces of them reveal nothing). Multi-place non-national victims reveal a union (~44%), single narrow place reveals ~20-25%. Danger: pool<=1000. Budget: avoid more than ~2 narrow single-place constraints all game. Day1: killed d1-3 (national) afternoon only. Watch pool at day3 conference.

Strategy: quick kills only in AFTERNOON, which keeps the pool to night, student and home routines (55%). KEY RULE: kill only victims reported in NATIONAL or FORUM (forum-only, or forum plus other places). Repeated traces of forum victims give the same constraint, so at worst the pool is about 55000*0.25 = 13750. Never add a second narrow constraint (docket, clips, North, foreign-only); worst case would be about 2750-3400. Two-place victims that include forum are fine. Day 1: killed d1-3 (national). Day 2: killed d2-1, d2-5 (forum), d2-4 (forum+foreign), d2-11 (national). Check the pool at the day 3 conference: expect 50000 or 10000-20000.
